prompt:
Build a nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom REMUS 100 autonomous underwater vehicle model with one screw propeller, a tail rudder, and a pair of stern planes. The hydrodynamic plant must respond to ocean-current speed and direction. Implement simultaneous closed-loop heading and depth control: the rudder controls heading and the stern planes control depth, while the propeller provides forward control authority. Do not replace the vehicle with a kinematic pose assignment or a decoupled pair of prescribed response traces.

Read HeadingInitial_deg, HeadingCommand_deg, HeadingStepTime_s, DepthInitial_m, DepthCommand_m, DepthStepTime_s, CurrentSpeed_mps, CurrentDirection_deg, and PropellerSpeed_rpm from the MATLAB base workspace. Support the declared ranges and apply them to the actual command, current, and propulsive paths. Internal controller form, reference shaping, and hydrodynamic implementation are not prescribed.

The scalar inputs are finite real values: HeadingInitial_deg [-20, 20] deg, HeadingCommand_deg [-75, 60] deg, HeadingStepTime_s [80, 130] s, DepthInitial_m [8, 15] m, DepthCommand_m [20, 40] m, DepthStepTime_s [170, 230] s, CurrentSpeed_mps [0.2, 0.8] m/s, CurrentDirection_deg [100, 240] deg, and PropellerSpeed_rpm [1300, 1525] rpm.

Run for 400 s. Across the declared range, keep the full vehicle state finite, respect physical rudder and stern-plane limits of approximately plus or minus 20 deg and propeller speed no greater than 1525 rpm, track both heading and depth commands, and recover after command changes without unstable roll, pitch, or cross-axis motion.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named reference_state, vehicle_state, actuation_state, and environment_state. reference_state has 4 channels in this order: heading command (deg), shaped heading (rad), depth command (m), and filtered depth (m). vehicle_state has 12 channels in this order: u, v, w (m/s); p, q, r (rad/s); north, east, down (m); and roll, pitch, yaw (rad). actuation_state has 4 channels in this order: rudder (rad), stern plane (rad), desired pitch (rad), and propeller speed (rpm). environment_state has 3 channels in this order: current speed (m/s), current direction (rad), and vehicle speed (m/s). Save the completed model as cand_XROBO05.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XROBO05.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
